headline.purpose: Section arguments and major calls to action.

shadows.name: focal-product
shadows.purpose: Lift one principal product demonstration from its field.

motion.name: arrow-nudge
motion.purpose: Small directional confirmation on primary CTA hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary conversion action used for demos and account creation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; background:#7141F8; color:#fff; border:0; border-radius:9999px; padding:12px 24px; font:600 14px/1.25 Lato,sans-serif; transition:background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#8D67FA; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #C6B3FC; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary conversion action paired with a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background:#fff; color:#303073; border:1px solid #7141F8; border-radius:9999px; padding:12px 24px; font:600 14px/1.25 Lato,sans-serif; transition:background-color 100ms ease-in,color 100ms ease-in; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:#7141F8; color:#fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #C6B3FC; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Feature Panel
components.description: A pale-violet structural field for product demonstrations.
components.css: .ds-feature-panel { background:#F3F1FF; color:#303073; border:1px solid #E3D9FE; border-radius:24px; padding:24px; font-family:Lato,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(100,76,170,.13); } .ds-feature-panel strong { font-size:14px; } .ds-feature-panel p { margin:16px 0 0; background:#fff; border-radius:12px; padding:12px; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: White marketing navigation with compact links and conversion actions.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; min-height:80px; padding:0 24px; background:#fff; color:#303073; border-bottom:1px solid #E5E5E5; font:500 14px/1.25 Lato,sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color:#525252; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#5F5FE1; } .ds-nav button { margin-left:auto; background:#7141F8; color:#fff; border:0; border-radius:9999px; padding:12px 24px; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible,.ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #C6B3FC; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Quiet rounded field used for footer subscription and compact forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; background:#fff; color:#303073; border:1px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 12px; font:400 14px/1.4 Lato,sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:#7141F8; outline:3px solid #E3D9FE; outline-offset:1px; }

narrative.overview: Zedu's public experience makes complicated education coordination feel ordered and approachable. White space carries most pages; violet identifies decisions, movement, and the product itself; deep indigo gives headlines authority without becoming corporate.
keyCharacteristics: Violet action color with deep-indigo editorial hierarchy.
Rounded controls and structural panels, not a page made entirely of cards.
Product-specific diagrams instead of invented metrics.

rules.name: Violet Means Action
rules.body: Reserve saturated violet for controls, active states, directional cues, and decisive branded regions.

rules.name: Heading Carries the Section
rules.body: Do not add decorative eyebrows above headings.

rules.name: One Focal Lift
rules.body: A section may elevate its principal product demonstration while supporting content stays flat.

dos: Do demonstrate how learning communication becomes structured.
Do use generous section spacing and clear heading scale.
Do keep mobile reading order complete and obvious.
Do use existing shared buttons and the Lucide stroke-icon family.
donts: Don't invent migration automation, customer proof, or performance metrics.
Don't build whole pages from identical icon cards.
Don't introduce decorative gradients, glass, or heavy shadows where content should carry the idea.
Don't use competitor logos or imply an official partnership.
